{{Short description|Stage of a football competition}}
The '''2023 Copa Sudamericana first stage''' was played from 7 to 9 March 2023.<ref name="calendar">{{cite web|url=https://d2soj90bepqxla.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/Calendario-2023_aprobado-Consejo-07-julio-2022.pdf|title=CALENDÁRIO 2023: CONMEBOL Libertadores - CONMEBOL Sudamericana - RECOPA|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=7 July 2022|access-date=7 July 2022|language=es}}</ref> A total of 32 teams competed in the first stage to decide 16 of the 32 places in the [[2023 Copa Sudamericana group stage|group stage]] of the [[2023 Copa Sudamericana]].

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw for the first stage was held on 21 December 2022, 12:00 [[Time in Paraguay|PYST]] ([[UTC−03:00|UTC−3]]), at the CONMEBOL Convention Centre in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/la-conmebol-sudamericana-con-nuevo-formato-ya-conoce-los-cruces-de-primera-fase/|title=La CONMEBOL Sudamericana con nuevo formato ya conoce los cruces de Primera Fase|trans-title=The CONMEBOL Sudamericana with new format already knows the First Stage matchups|language=es|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=21 December 2022|access-date=21 December 2022}}</ref> For the first stage, the 32 teams involved were divided into eight pots according to their national association.

The 32 teams were drawn into 16 ties, with the four teams from each national association being drawn against a rival from the same association in two ties per association.<section end=Draw />

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
In the first stage, each tie was played as a [[Single-elimination tournament|single-leg]] match.<ref name="changes2023">{{cite web |url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/con-cambios-en-el-formato-la-conmebol-sudamericana-gana-aun-mas-competitividad-y-atractivo/ |title=Con cambios en el formato, la CONMEBOL Sudamericana gana aún más competitividad y atractivo |trans-title=With changes in the format, the CONMEBOL Sudamericana gains even more competitiveness and attractiveness |language=es |publisher=CONMEBOL |date=19 December 2022 |access-date=20 December 2022}}</ref> If tied after 90 minutes, [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] would not be played, and a [[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] would be used to determine the winner (Regulations Article 2.4.2).

The 16 winners of the first stage advanced to the [[2023 Copa Sudamericana group stage|group stage]] to join the 12 teams directly qualified for that stage (six from Argentina and six from Brazil), and four teams transferred from the [[2023 Copa Libertadores|Copa Libertadores]] (the four [[2023 Copa Libertadores qualifying stages#Third stage|teams]] eliminated in the [[2023 Copa Libertadores qualifying stages#Third stage|third stage]] of [[2023 Copa Libertadores qualifying stages|qualifying]]).<section end=Format />

==Matches==
Matches in this round were played on 7–9 March 2023.<ref name="fixture">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/fixtures-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-y-la-conmebol-sudamericana-2023/|title=Fixtures de la CONMEBOL Libertadores y la CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2023|trans-title=2023 CONMEBOL Libertadores and CONMEBOL Sudamericana Fixtures|language=es|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=22 December 2022|access-date=22 December 2022}}</ref><ref name="fixture_pdf">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/Fixture_CONMEBOL-Sudamericana-Primera-Fase_22-12-2022.pdf|title=CONMEBOL SUDAMERICANA 2023 PROGRAMA DE PARTIDOS {{!}} Departamento de Competiciones y Operaciones {{!}} Versión de 22/12/2022|language=es|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=22 December 2022|access-date=22 December 2022}}</ref><ref name="fixture_pdf_2">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/Fixture_CONMEBOL-Sudamericana-Primera-Fase_17-02-2023.pdf|title=CONMEBOL SUDAMERICANA 2023 PROGRAMA DE PARTIDOS {{!}} Departamento de Competiciones y Operaciones {{!}} Versión de 17/02/2023|language=es|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=17 February 2023|access-date=18 February 2023}}</ref>
